title: BubbleEggs
body:
## **BubbleEggs** - **Catch Mobs with Customizable Projectiles!**

Transform your server's mob interaction with BubbleEggs! This feature-rich plugin allows players to catch mobs and convert them into spawn eggs using customizable projectiles - perfect for survival servers, minigames, and creative gameplay mechanics.

### **✨ Key Features:**## 
• **Catch Any Mob** - Support for all Minecraft mobs including bosses, golems, and mobs without vanilla spawn eggs
• **Customizable Catch Capsules** - Define the projectile (snowball, egg, ender pearl, etc.) with custom names, lore, and CustomModelData
• **Flexible Mechanics** - Throw or punch mobs to catch them with configurable catch rates per mob
• **Economy Integration** - Set money or item costs for catching (Vault support)
• **Save Mob Data** - Preserve mob attributes like name, health, and equipment (NBTAPI support)
• **WorldGuard Integration** - Control catching in specific regions
• **Spawner Management** - Allow or deny players from changing spawner types
• **Full Customization** - Individual settings for each mob type with catch chances, costs, and requirements
• **Beautiful Effects** - Particles and sounds for successful/failed catches
• **HEX Color Support** - Modern color codes for all messages

### **Perfect For:**
• Survival servers wanting unique mob capture mechanics
• Skyblock and prison servers for mob farming
• RPG servers with custom catching mechanics
• Minigames requiring mob collection

### **Requirements:**
• **Minecraft 1.21.9+** (Spigot/Paper)
• **Java 21+**

### **Soft Dependencies:**
• **Vault** (for economy features)
• **NBTAPI** (for saving entity data)
• **WorldGuard** (for region control)

### **⚙️ Commands & Permissions:**
Simple command structure with /mte for help, reload, giving capsules, and bulk updates. Granular permissions for catching, bypass options, spawner changes, and more.

### **Highly Configurable:**
Three configuration files allow you to customize every aspect - catch capsule appearance, per-mob settings, catching mechanics, costs, effects, and fully translatable messages with language file support.

Documentation | [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/Ethan0892/BubbleEggs/issues) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/Wfb3Hxxavt)

Works perfectly out of the box with sensible defaults, or dive deep into configuration for complete control over your server's mob catching experience!
